usaspending OVERRIDES the J-Book blind spot: ESA Night Vision LLC has $139M ENVG-B Production Delivery Order 02 in 2025 (W91CRB25F0071) plus $126.9M, $116.4M, and $89.5M Squad Binocular Night Vision Goggle awards on contract family M67854 (USMC) — i.e., ESA is the actual fielded supplier of both Army ENVG-B and USMC SBNVG.
This is the strongest positive verification in the sweep: the claim about 'advanced night vision' is not just narrative — it is anchored to live, FY2025 production awards >$450M cumulative.
scores.M_value: J-Book: corpus gap. USAspending: confirmed active ENVG-B and SBNVG production orders >$450M in last ~24 months.
scores.interpretation: PASS. Forward-positioning claim independently corroborated by USAspending production awards. No J-Book divergence.

notes: Foreign-issuer caveat 2 applies: J-Book mostly informs C2 (Israeli Cooperative Programs PE 0603913C — Elbit named primary contractor; FUNDED_STEADY $300M/yr through FY2026; MoU runs to FY2028) and C4 (F-35 C2D2 FUNDED_STEADY).

USAspending was the workhorse for ESA-side claims (C1/C3/C7/C10): RECURRING_FEDERAL with $886M across 810 ESA UEI contracts. Top awards confirm ENVG-B and SBNVG production lines (Army W91CRB / USMC M67854).

No J-BOOK EXPOSURE DIVERGENCE detected at the 2026-05-20 cutoff for this filing. The forward DoD lines Elbit names (Iron Fist for Bradley, F-35 HMDS, ENVG-B, Israeli Cooperative Programs) are either FUNDED_STEADY in the J-Book corpus or corroborated by recurring usaspending obligations.
Heuristic 3 (reorganization) and 5 (earmark sunset) did not trigger.

Coverage limitation: 410-program J-Book corpus does NOT cover Army Procurement Bradley APS line, ENVG-B Soldier system procurement line, or DIRCM/LAIRCM PEs — so the test is anchored on the one PE where Elbit is explicitly listed (0603913C) plus the F-35 parent program. usaspending is the primary verifier for the ESA-side concentration.
